seo.title: Security Checklist for Solana Developers
seo.description: A comprehensive checklist covering account validation, PDA security, CPI safety, and Solana program security best practices.

content.intro: Solana's account model creates unique security considerations. Use this checklist to ensure your programs are secure against common attack vectors.

items.text: Verify account owner matches expected program ID
items.title: Verify account owner matches expected program ID

items.text: Check account discriminator to ensure correct account type
items.title: Check account discriminator to ensure correct account type

items.text: Validate signer status for accounts that should authorize actions
items.title: Validate signer status for accounts that should authorize actions

items.text: Check writable flag for accounts that will be modified
items.title: Check writable flag for accounts that will be modified

items.text: Verify account is initialized before reading data
items.title: Verify account is initialized before reading data

items.text: Validate account data length matches expected size
items.title: Validate account data length matches expected size

items.text: Check that accounts are not closed (lamports = 0)
items.title: Check that accounts are not closed (lamports = 0)

items.text: Verify rent-exempt status for accounts that should persist
items.title: Verify rent-exempt status for accounts that should persist

items.text: Use consistent seeds for PDA derivation across program and client
items.title: Use consistent seeds for PDA derivation across program and client

items.text: Store bump seed in account data to avoid recalculation
items.title: Store bump seed in account data to avoid recalculation

items.text: Validate PDA derivation on-chain, don't trust client-provided PDAs
items.title: Validate PDA derivation on-chain, don't trust client-provided PDAs

items.text: Use create_program_address for validation, not find_program_address
items.title: Use create_program_address for validation, not find_program_address

items.text: Include unique identifiers in seeds to prevent collisions
items.title: Include unique identifiers in seeds to prevent collisions

items.text: Document seed structure clearly for maintainability
items.title: Document seed structure clearly for maintainability

items.text: Use canonical bump (the one from find_program_address)
items.title: Use canonical bump (the one from find_program_address)

items.text: Keep total seed length under 32 bytes
items.title: Keep total seed length under 32 bytes

items.text: Verify token account mint matches expected token
items.title: Verify token account mint matches expected token

items.text: Check token account owner is the expected user/PDA
items.title: Check token account owner is the expected user/PDA

items.text: Validate token program ID (SPL Token vs Token-2022)
items.title: Validate token program ID (SPL Token vs Token-2022)

items.text: Account for token decimals in all calculations
items.title: Account for token decimals in all calculations

items.text: Check token account is not frozen before transfers
items.title: Check token account is not frozen before transfers

items.text: Verify associated token account derivation
items.title: Verify associated token account derivation

items.text: Handle close authority properly for token accounts
items.title: Handle close authority properly for token accounts

items.text: Check delegate and delegated amount for token accounts
items.title: Check delegate and delegated amount for token accounts

items.text: Use checked arithmetic (checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul)
items.title: Use checked arithmetic (checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul)

items.text: Handle division by zero explicitly
items.title: Handle division by zero explicitly

items.text: Consider precision loss in division operations
items.title: Consider precision loss in division operations

items.text: Round in protocol's favor, not user's favor
items.title: Round in protocol's favor, not user's favor

items.text: Use saturating arithmetic where appropriate
items.title: Use saturating arithmetic where appropriate

items.text: Validate numeric inputs are within expected ranges
items.title: Validate numeric inputs are within expected ranges

items.text: Use fixed-point math for financial calculations
items.title: Use fixed-point math for financial calculations

items.text: Test edge cases with minimum and maximum values
items.title: Test edge cases with minimum and maximum values

items.text: Validate target program ID before CPI
items.title: Validate target program ID before CPI

items.text: Use hardcoded program IDs, not account-provided ones
items.title: Use hardcoded program IDs, not account-provided ones

items.text: Pass correct signer seeds for PDA-signed CPIs
items.title: Pass correct signer seeds for PDA-signed CPIs

items.text: Follow checks-effects-interactions pattern
items.title: Follow checks-effects-interactions pattern

items.text: Update state before making CPIs to prevent reentrancy
items.title: Update state before making CPIs to prevent reentrancy

items.text: Check CPI return values for success
items.title: Check CPI return values for success

items.text: Limit CPIs to known, audited programs
items.title: Limit CPIs to known, audited programs

items.text: Document CPI trust assumptions
items.title: Document CPI trust assumptions

items.text: Implement proper authority checks for admin functions
items.title: Implement proper authority checks for admin functions

items.text: Use multi-sig or governance for critical operations
items.title: Use multi-sig or governance for critical operations

items.text: Implement upgrade authority controls
items.title: Implement upgrade authority controls

items.text: Add timelock for sensitive parameter changes
items.title: Add timelock for sensitive parameter changes

items.text: Document all privileged operations
items.title: Document all privileged operations

items.text: Allow authority transfer/revocation
items.title: Allow authority transfer/revocation

items.text: Validate authority accounts are signers
items.title: Validate authority accounts are signers

items.text: Consider program freezing for emergencies
items.title: Consider program freezing for emergencies

items.text: Initialize all account fields explicitly
items.title: Initialize all account fields explicitly

items.text: Use proper serialization/deserialization
items.title: Use proper serialization/deserialization

items.text: Handle account resizing carefully
items.title: Handle account resizing carefully

items.text: Clean up closed accounts properly
items.title: Clean up closed accounts properly

items.text: Prevent duplicate initialization
items.title: Prevent duplicate initialization

items.text: Use version field for future migrations
items.title: Use version field for future migrations

items.text: Validate state transitions are valid
items.title: Validate state transitions are valid

items.text: Document account lifecycle
items.title: Document account lifecycle

items.text: Use Clock sysvar for timestamps, not block data
items.title: Use Clock sysvar for timestamps, not block data

items.text: Handle i64 timestamps correctly (not u64)
items.title: Handle i64 timestamps correctly (not u64)

items.text: Consider slot vs Unix timestamp based on precision needs
items.title: Consider slot vs Unix timestamp based on precision needs

items.text: Account for clock skew in time-sensitive operations
items.title: Account for clock skew in time-sensitive operations

items.text: Don't trust future timestamps from users
items.title: Don't trust future timestamps from users

items.text: Implement reasonable timelock durations
items.title: Implement reasonable timelock durations

items.text: Write comprehensive unit tests with Bankrun
items.title: Write comprehensive unit tests with Bankrun

items.text: Test on devnet with realistic conditions
items.title: Test on devnet with realistic conditions

items.text: Test all error paths, not just happy paths
items.title: Test all error paths, not just happy paths

items.text: Use fuzzing (Trident) for complex logic
items.title: Use fuzzing (Trident) for complex logic

items.text: Test with invalid account inputs
items.title: Test with invalid account inputs

items.text: Test arithmetic edge cases
items.title: Test arithmetic edge cases

items.text: Test CPI failure scenarios
items.title: Test CPI failure scenarios

items.text: Verify compute unit usage under load
items.title: Verify compute unit usage under load

items.text: Verify program builds are reproducible
items.title: Verify program builds are reproducible

items.text: Use verified builds on-chain
items.title: Use verified builds on-chain

items.text: Store upgrade authority securely (multi-sig)
items.title: Store upgrade authority securely (multi-sig)

items.text: Test upgrade procedure before mainnet
items.title: Test upgrade procedure before mainnet

items.text: Document deployment and upgrade process
items.title: Document deployment and upgrade process

items.text: Consider making program immutable after stabilization
items.title: Consider making program immutable after stabilization

items.text: Monitor program after deployment
items.title: Monitor program after deployment

items.text: Have incident response plan ready
items.title: Have incident response plan ready

proTips: Account validation is the most common source of Solana vulnerabilities. Check every account constraint.
Test with the exact version of the Solana CLI you will deploy with.
Use Anchor constraints (has_one, constraint) instead of manual checks.
